instruction: In the opened `scene.blend`, keep mesh object `Face`, armature object `Rig`, bone `ctrl_jaw`, and shape key `smile`. For this workflow, the Blender executable is `/opt/blender/blender`; use it to open `scene.blend`. Add a driver to `Face.data.shape_keys.key_blocks['smile'].value` and save the completed scene as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`. The driver's first variable must target `Rig` / `ctrl_jaw` with `transform_type = 'ROT_X'`. The expression must contain clamp logic and a factor of 2 applied to the driver variable. When `Rig.pose.bones['ctrl_jaw'].rotation_euler.x` is set to `0.5`, `0.1`, and `-0.3`, the evaluated `smile` value must be `1.0`, `0.2`, and `0.0` respectively, within `1e-3`.
